reason: All Turmoil VP/Vizier/leader/map/Evening consequences supplied with no false extra.

question.question: What exactly happens in Turmoil, including Viziers, leaders, pieces on map and the rest of the turn?

expected.expected_answer: Lose one VP per bird card including Loyal Viziers; discard Decree except Viziers; flip current leader face down, choose face-up new leader, retuck Viziers as listed. If none face up flip all face up. End Daylight, proceed Evening including roost scoring and draw/discard. No removal of map warriors/buildings.

source_passages.quotation: **Turmoil, in order:** Lose one VP per bird Decree card **including both Loyal Viziers**; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck Viziers in new leader's columns. End Daylight and proceed to the full normal Evening: **score the roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard to five**. **Turmoil does not remove your map warriors or buildings.**

answer.ruling: Lose one VP for each bird Decree card, including both Loyal Viziers; discard every Decree card except Viziers; flip the current leader face down and choose a face-up replacement. If none are face up, flip all leaders face up before choosing. Retuck Viziers in the new leader’s columns.
End Daylight and take the full normal Evening: score the roost track, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, then discard down to five. Turmoil does not remove map warriors or buildings.
